servinfo.title: Rear Door Lock Assembly Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Remove rear door sash and rear door glass.
Remove lock (2) in arrow direction “1” and then move door lock open rod (3) in arrow direction “2” to remove it from outside door handle (1).
Disconnect rear door lock connector (4) from rear door lock assembly (5).
Remove inside door handle (7) by moving it in arrow directions “3” and “4”.
Remove inside door handle and rear door lock assembly as a unit.
Remove inside door handle cable clip (8).
Remove door lock wires (1) from inside door handle (2) by pulling them in arrow direction.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Tighten door latch striker screws to specified torque.
Apply grease to sliding and rotation parts of door lock assembly.
Tighten each screw to specified torque referring to Rear Door Lock Components .
Move door latch striker (2) up or down to align its center with the center of groove (3) on rear door lock assembly (1) as shown in figure.
Move door latch striker (1) to adjust rear door panel surface (2) becomes flush with side body outer panel surface (3) as shown in figure.
